nodes.label: Tree Shaking
nodes.rationale: Only bundle components actually used in consumer code to reduce load size and improve runtime performance.

nodes.label: SSR Compatibility
nodes.rationale: Components work in server-side rendering projects; validated via uilib-next test project.

nodes.label: DRY KISS SOLID Principles
nodes.rationale: Codebase follows DRY, KISS, and SOLID software development principles.

nodes.label: PromptComposer
nodes.rationale: Slash-enabled composer component added in v5.3.0; later fixes for destroyed editor guard, scroll, and DOM prop omission.

nodes.label: Tooltip
nodes.rationale: Component introduced in changelog; evolved with classNames and disabled prop support.

nodes.label: Slider
nodes.rationale: Range input with timeline markers and markerTooltipProps integrating tooltips.

nodes.label: Theme
nodes.rationale: v5.0.0 design refresh including Card, Dialogue, and ThemeProvider.

nodes.label: Gallery
nodes.rationale: Supports mixed image and video items; dots reflect full items list length.

nodes.label: UILIB HTML Shell Template
nodes.rationale: Webpack HTML template providing base document structure, viewport meta, and dual React mount points for app and modals.

nodes.label: app-modal Mount Point
nodes.rationale: Separate DOM root for modal overlays, decoupled from main app rendering tree.

nodes.label: Tooltip Component
nodes.rationale: Ultra-efficient tooltip system using Popover API with fallback; supports individual Tooltip wrapper or global TooltipProvider pattern.

nodes.label: Popover API
nodes.rationale: Uses native browser Popover API with automatic fallback for browsers lacking support.

nodes.label: data-tooltip Attribute Pattern
nodes.rationale: Declarative HTML attributes (data-tooltip, data-tooltip-direction, data-tooltip-blur) drive tooltip content and placement without React wrappers.

nodes.label: Event Delegation
nodes.rationale: Single delegated listener reduces memory usage and avoids React re-renders on hover.

nodes.label: Smart Viewport Positioning
nodes.rationale: Auto-adjusts tooltip placement to stay within viewport bounds.

nodes.label: Tooltip Blur Glassmorphism
nodes.rationale: Optional backdrop-filter blur for modern glassmorphism tooltip styling via blur prop or data-tooltip-blur attribute.
